status: PRE-REGISTERED BEFORE EXECUTION. Immutable and additive. Nothing here may be edited after the first execution; a correction must be a new additive addendum.
authorized_by: architect, 2026-08-25, as a ONE-VARIABLE SCREENING only

derived_from.relationship: B1R2-B is B1R2-A with EXACTLY ONE field changed: the learning rate. Every other configuration value is asserted programmatically to be identical to the B1R2-A executor's.

role: SCREENING. This arm can falsify one hypothesis; it cannot establish a limit of the observation contract, and the protocol forbids that conclusion. See stop_go.forbidden_conclusions.

hypothesis.statement: Head-swing and cycle1-swing rows overlap in the effective 23D support and each branch is internally consistent (median |delta target| 0.0 within head, 0.04486663639545441 within cycle1) while conflicting across (0.1670604795217514). No exact collision exists: the minimum pair distance is 0.030914171900546916 and the B1R2 rev1 audit found zero pairs within 1e-3. A sharper function could therefore in principle separate the branches. A finer optimisation step may allow the model to reach such a function from the same B0 init, instead of oscillating in a wide basin - consistent with the 44% epoch-to-epoch spread of the B1R2-A pooled curve and with per-fold argmins scattered between 367 and 1189.
what_is_NOT_tested_here: no reweighting, resampling or per-segment loss
no change of budget, patience, selection rule or fold design
no architecture, capacity, observation-contract or masking change
no dataset scope change: the three V26 anchors and all 1500 rows stay
no FSM v3, morphology, contact, reward, C++ or SEA change
no gradient clipping, which remains absent

experiment_matrix.everything_else: asserted equal to the B1R2-A executor by programmatic check, not by prose

learning_rate_injection.mechanism: v26b_b_exec.fit_masked gained a keyword-only optional parameter `lr` whose default is None, resolved to the pinned J_LR. Omitting it reproduces the previous behaviour byte for byte.
learning_rate_injection.pinned_constant_untouched: J_LR remains 3e-4; the constant is not edited and the existing suites that assert it still pass
learning_rate_injection.only_injectable_hyperparameter: every other hyperparameter stays module-level and cannot be reached by a caller
learning_rate_injection.equivalence_proof: The executor test calls v26b_b_exec.fit_masked TWICE on the SAME fold - fold 6, the 11-row minus020 tail - for 4 EPOCHS each: once omitting `lr`, once passing lr=J_LR explicitly. It requires the two recorded validation curves to be identical value for value over those 4 epochs. That demonstrates the injection changed nothing except making the value settable.
learning_rate_injection.what_the_proof_is_NOT: It is NOT a comparison against the fold curve recorded by B1R2-A, and no such comparison is performed or claimed. An earlier draft of this field asserted a bit-identical match against B1R2-A's recorded curve; that overstated the test and is corrected here before execution.
learning_rate_injection.contrast_run: The test also runs the same fold for 4 EPOCHS at lr=1e-4 and requires the trajectory to differ from the default run over those 4 epochs, and the state after the FIRST recorded epoch to sit closer to B0 than the default run's, as a smaller step must.
learning_rate_injection.wider_regression_evidence: Separately, the six test suites that existed before the injection (673 checks in total) all pass unchanged, and the pinned constant J_LR is still asserted to be 3e-4 by three of them.

integrity_control_NOT_a_falsifier.why: This quantity is computed from the dataset alone - raw observations and teacher labels - and contains no model output. It is invariant to the learning rate and to every optimisation hyperparameter. A criterion that cannot move under the intervention cannot falsify anything; listing it as a falsifier was a logical error, now corrected.
integrity_control_NOT_a_falsifier.role: integrity and sanity control. If it changes, the run is INVALIDATED regardless of the gates, because the data pipeline has broken - dataset, caches, labels, ordering or row construction.
integrity_control_NOT_a_falsifier.definition: pairs of head-swing x cycle1-swing rows, FSM signature SWING/credit-0.5, euclidean distance in the RAW effective 23D, excluding same-trajectory pairs within embargo 20
integrity_control_NOT_a_falsifier.asserted: exactly, in floating point equality, by the executor test before any fit may start

full_curve_convergence_diagnostic.correction: An earlier draft of this protocol treated the exhaustion of the SELECTION rule's patience as evidence of convergence. That was a logical error and is corrected here before any hash or execution.
full_curve_convergence_diagnostic.why_the_earlier_form_was_wrong: Exhausting the July scan means the rule stopped LOOKING, not that the curve settled. Arm A is the proof: its selection scan stopped at epoch 297, yet the global minimum of its full 1200-epoch pooled curve was at epoch 1171 and was LOWER (MSE 0.001697248, RMSE 0.0411977, against 0.002309152 / 0.0480536 at the selected e*=237). The two quantities are different and must never be conflated.
full_curve_convergence_diagnostic.definition: The FULL pooled curve is CONVERGED at this budget if and only if its GLOBAL minimum falls at or before epoch 1140 AND no epoch among the following 60 improves on it by more than 1e-9. An argmin later than 1140 means NOT CONVERGED at the budget.
full_curve_convergence_diagnostic.does_not_change_selection: The binding selection of e* is UNCHANGED and remains July's patience-60 rule applied to the pooled curve. This diagnostic is purely interpretive and can never move e*, a gate or the verdict.
full_curve_convergence_diagnostic.retrospective_on_arm_A: Under this definition arm A itself was NOT converged at its budget: its full-curve argmin was 1171 > 1140. This is recorded so arm A's own NO-GO is not over-read either.

gates.source: imported from v26b_b1r1_exec; never restated by hand; not relaxed

binding.requirement: 10 keys, width 35, columns 0:2 and 25:35 exactly zero, no masked update, logstd byte-identical to B0, critic never loaded

binding.definition: sqrt(pooled(e*)), the out-of-fold aggregate RMSE over all 1313 non-WAIT rows

stop_go.GO: promote a candidate ONLY if ALL binding gates pass AND the integrity control matches exactly. Promotion writes candidates/B1R2B_BASE35_LR1E4/.
stop_go.NO_GO: if ANY binding gate fails: STOP offline. No candidate, no rollout, no collection, no DAgger, no autonomous arm C. Report exactly which gates, folds and regions fail.
stop_go.INVALIDATED: if the integrity control does not match its pinned values, the run is invalid and its verdict must not be interpreted at all
forbidden_conclusions: A NO-GO in this arm does NOT establish a limit of the observation contract. With the learning rate reduced threefold and the budget FIXED at 1200 epochs, arm B covers less optimisation distance than arm A, so a NO-GO is confounded between 'the sharpness hypothesis is false' and 'the optimisation simply did not arrive'. The two are indistinguishable from the verdict alone and the contract conclusion is forbidden whatever the outcome.
A non-converged curve must be reported as 'inconclusive screening, insufficient advancement', never as an informative NO-GO.
No comparison against July's 6.63e-05 validation MSE, which came from a random split of a 32x-repeated dataset and is not a generalisation measurement.

Do NOT describe the exhaustion of the selection rule's patience as an interior minimum or as convergence. Arm A exhausted its scan at epoch 297 while its full-curve global minimum was at 1171 and was lower.
stop_go.if_not_converged: the only legitimate follow-up is an arm with an adequate budget, TO BE AUTHORISED EXPLICITLY; it may not be started autonomously. 'Not converged' is decided by full_curve_convergence_diagnostic, never by the selection rule's patience.
stop_go.no_post_hoc: no threshold, hyperparameter or rule may be changed after seeing any number. A failure is recorded as a failure.
stop_go.single_execution: one execution only; no retry; artefacts preserved on failure

prohibited_in_this_stage: any change to fit_masked semantics beyond the optional lr whose default preserves behaviour
any promotion without a full gate pass
